master.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Generate Mammoth heavy-haul game vehicle: olive prime mover with attached lowbed carrying one enormous 50-ton granite boulder chained securely into a steel frame. High cab ladder, huge mirrors, heavy grime and chipped paint. Exactly THREE road axle positions TOTAL across complete combined rig: one at front beneath cab at right, two supporting rear lowbed at left. Three identical 1.52m mud-terrain tires with twin-ring tractor chains and centered steel rims. Premium semi-realistic painted game illustration matching Swamp Scout, dark readable contours, rich weathered mechanical detail. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Facing RIGHT. Cab front face invisible; horizontal chassis and deck. Every tire fully visible and perfectly circular. Whole rig and load with clear margins. Wide PNG at least 1500 pixels long. True transparent background, no ground, shadows, halo, checkerboard, text, logos, watermark.
